rules.title: Prohibition on using or distributing common pricing algorithms in restraint of trade
rules.quote: It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of this chapter.
rules.summary: It is unlawful to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination, or conspiracy that restrains trade or commerce.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Approved by Governor October 06, 2025. Filed with Secretary of State October 06, 2025.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to any person using or distributing a common pricing algorithm (methodology used by two or more persons that uses competitor data to recommend, align, stabilize, set, or otherwise influence a price or commercial term) as part of restraint of trade
rules.exemption_note: End consumers of a product or service are not included in the definition of 'person' subject to this law
rules.penalty: Violation is punishable as a crime under the Cartwright Act

rules.title: Prohibition on coercing price adoption from common pricing algorithm
rules.quote: It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services in the jurisdiction of this state.
rules.summary: It is unlawful to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if you coerce another person to adopt a recommended price or commercial term for the same or similar products or services.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Approved by Governor October 06, 2025. Filed with Secretary of State October 06, 2025.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to any person who coerces another to set or adopt recommended prices or commercial terms from a common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services
rules.exemption_note: End consumers of a product or service are not included in the definition of 'person' subject to this law
rules.penalty: Violation is punishable as a crime under the Cartwright Act
